objects.definition: typedef struct png_struct_def png_struct;
objects.description: Opaque core libpng read/write context structure holding codec state, I/O, error handlers, transforms, etc. Only forward-declared here; managed via libpng create/destroy APIs.

objects.definition: typedef struct png_info_def png_info;
objects.description: Opaque structure holding image header and ancillary chunk metadata for read/write operations.
RGB palette entry with 8-bit per-channel samples.
High-depth color/gray value or palette index used by chunks like bKGD/tRNS.
Bit-depth indicators per channel (sBIT chunk representation).
Single suggested-palette entry for sPLT chunk; 16-bit components plus usage frequency.
Container for one sPLT (suggested palette) chunk including name, depth and entries array.

objects.definition:
typedef struct png_text_struct
{
   int  compression;       /* compression value: */
   char *key;              /* keyword, 1-79 character description of "text" */
   char *text;             /* comment, may be an empty string (ie "")
                              or a NULL pointer */
   size_t text_length;     /* length of the text string */
   size_t itxt_length;     /* length of the itxt string */
   char *lang;             /* language code, 0-79 characters
                              or a NULL pointer */
   char *lang_key;         /* keyword translated UTF-8 string, 0 or more
                              chars or a NULL pointer */
} png_text;
objects.description: Holds textual chunk payload (tEXt/zTXt/iTXt), including keyword, content, compression, language metadata.
Portable time representation used by the tIME chunk and related APIs.
Holds raw data for chunks not natively handled by libpng, enabling preservation or custom processing.
Per-row format/size descriptor passed to user transform callbacks.

objects.definition: typedef struct png_control_def png_control;
objects.description: Opaque internal control object used by the simplified API to manage state/resources behind png_image.
Public struct describing images for the simplified read/write API, including dimensions, format, flags, colormap size, and last error/warning message.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned char png_byte;
objects.description: Unsigned 8-bit byte type used throughout libpng for raw data and components. Aliases include const and pointer-to-pointer variants.

objects.definition:
#if INT_MIN == -32768 && INT_MAX == 32767
   typedef int png_int_16;
#elif SHRT_MIN == -32768 && SHRT_MAX == 32767
   typedef short png_int_16;
#else
#  error libpng requires a signed 16-bit integer type
#endif
objects.description: Signed 16-bit integer typedef used for various fields and calculations.

objects.definition:
#if UINT_MAX == 65535
   typedef unsigned int png_uint_16;
#elif USHRT_MAX == 65535
   typedef unsigned short png_uint_16;
#else
#  error libpng requires an unsigned 16-bit integer type
#endif
objects.description: Unsigned 16-bit integer typedef used for chunk data and sample values.

objects.definition:
#if INT_MIN < -2147483646 && INT_MAX > 2147483646
   typedef int png_int_32;
#elif LONG_MIN < -2147483646 && LONG_MAX > 2147483646
   typedef long int png_int_32;
#else
#  error libpng requires a signed 32-bit (or longer) integer type
#endif
objects.description: Signed 32-bit (or wider) integer typedef used in APIs and structures.

objects.definition:
#if UINT_MAX > 4294967294U
   typedef unsigned int png_uint_32;
#elif ULONG_MAX > 4294967294U
   typedef unsigned long int png_uint_32;
#else
#  error libpng requires an unsigned 32-bit (or longer) integer type
#endif
objects.description: Unsigned 32-bit (or wider) integer typedef widely used for sizes, counts, pixel coordinates.

objects.definition: typedef size_t png_size_t;
objects.description: Alias for size_t maintained for backward compatibility.

objects.definition: typedef ptrdiff_t png_ptrdiff_t;
objects.description: Alias for ptrdiff_t for backward compatibility.
Allocation size type guaranteed to be at least as wide as size_t and png_uint_32; used for libpng memory APIs.

objects.definition: typedef png_int_32 png_fixed_point;
objects.description: Fixed-point 16.16-like integer for gamma and chromaticity scaled by 100000.

objects.definition: typedef void                  *png_voidp;
objects.description: Deprecated generic void* alias used in older libpng APIs.

objects.definition: typedef const void            *png_const_voidp;
objects.description: Deprecated const void* alias used in older libpng APIs.

objects.definition:
typedef char                  *png_charp;
typedef const char            *png_const_charp;
objects.description: Deprecated aliases for C strings used by older APIs; includes pointer-to-pointer and triple-pointer variants for legacy interfaces.

functions.name: png_access_version_number
functions.description: Returns the libpng version number as an integer constant. Typical use is for runtime/library-capability checks.

functions.name: png_set_sig_bytes
functions.description: Informs libpng how many initial signature bytes (from the PNG file signature) the application has already read and consumed externally.
requirements: num_bytes must be between 0 and 8 inclusive; handling more than 8 bytes from the beginning of the file is an error.
png_ptr must be a valid, initialized read or read/write png_struct.

functions.name: png_sig_cmp
functions.signature: int png_sig_cmp(const png_byte *sig, size_t start, size_t num_to_check);
functions.description: Checks a buffer for the 8-byte PNG signature starting at a given offset. Returns 0 if the supplied bytes match the PNG signature, non-zero otherwise.
requirements: sig must point to at least start + num_to_check bytes.
num_to_check should be > 0 to perform a check.
start must be <= 7; start > 7 always causes a non-zero (failure) return.
Only compares up to 8 signature bytes.

functions.name: png_create_read_struct
functions.signature: png_struct * png_create_read_struct(const char *user_png_ver, void *error_ptr, png_error_ptr error_fn, png_error_ptr warn_fn);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a png_struct for reading, and sets custom error/warning callbacks if provided. Use PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING for user_png_ver.
requirements: user_png_ver should match the library version string (typically PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING).
error_fn and warn_fn may be NULL to use defaults; error_ptr is passed back to those callbacks.
Returns NULL on allocation/ABI mismatch failures; callers must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: png_create_write_struct
functions.signature: png_struct * png_create_write_struct(const char *user_png_ver, void *error_ptr, png_error_ptr error_fn, png_error_ptr warn_fn);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a png_struct for writing, with optional custom error/warning callbacks. Use PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING for user_png_ver.
requirements: user_png_ver should match the library version string (typically PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING).
error_fn and warn_fn may be NULL to use defaults; error_ptr is passed back to those callbacks.
Returns NULL on allocation/ABI mismatch failures; callers must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: png_get_compression_buffer_size
functions.description: Returns the current size of the internal compression buffer used by libpng.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized png_struct.

functions.name: png_set_compression_buffer_size
functions.description: Sets the size of the internal compression buffer used by libpng.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized png_struct.
size must be a valid size_t value; specific minimum/maximum not documented here.

functions.name: png_set_longjmp_fn
functions.signature: jmp_buf* png_set_longjmp_fn(png_struct *png_ptr, png_longjmp_ptr longjmp_fn, size_t jmp_buf_size);
functions.description: Associates a jmp_buf owned by libpng with the png_struct and records the longjmp function to use for error aborts. Returns a pointer to libpng’s internal jmp_buf, or NULL if the jmp_buf size does not match (indicating an ABI mismatch).
requirements: Only available when PNG_SETJMP_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be valid.
longjmp_fn may be NULL only if the default error function has been overridden; otherwise supply a compatible longjmp function.
jmp_buf_size must equal sizeof(jmp_buf) in the application; otherwise the function returns NULL.

functions.name: png_longjmp
functions.description: Performs a non-returning longjmp using the longjmp function previously registered via png_set_longjmp_fn. If no longjmp function is available, the library aborts.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid and must have been set up with png_set_longjmp_fn unless the default error function was overridden appropriately.
This function does not return; callers must not expect control to continue after the call.

functions.name: png_reset_zstream
functions.description: Resets the internal zlib compression stream. Marked as deprecated in the header.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid and configured for reading.
Deprecated: new code should avoid relying on this function.

functions.name: png_create_read_struct_2
functions.signature: png_struct * png_create_read_struct_2(const char *user_png_ver, void *error_ptr, png_error_ptr error_fn, png_error_ptr warn_fn, void *mem_ptr, png_malloc_ptr malloc_fn, png_free_ptr free_fn);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a png_struct for reading with user-supplied memory allocation functions in addition to optional error/warning callbacks. Use PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING for user_png_ver.
requirements: Only available when PNG_USER_MEM_SUPPORTED is enabled.
user_png_ver should match the library version string.
malloc_fn and free_fn must be valid if custom allocation is desired; mem_ptr is passed back to these callbacks.
Returns NULL on allocation/ABI mismatch failures; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: png_create_write_struct_2
functions.signature: png_struct * png_create_write_struct_2(const char *user_png_ver, void *error_ptr, png_error_ptr error_fn, png_error_ptr warn_fn, void *mem_ptr, png_malloc_ptr malloc_fn, png_free_ptr free_fn);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a png_struct for writing with user-supplied memory allocation functions and optional error/warning callbacks. Use PNG_LIBPNG_VER_STRING for user_png_ver.
requirements: Only available when PNG_USER_MEM_SUPPORTED is enabled.
user_png_ver should match the library version string.
malloc_fn and free_fn must be valid if custom allocation is desired; mem_ptr is passed back to these callbacks.
Returns NULL on allocation/ABI mismatch failures; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: png_write_sig
functions.description: Writes the 8-byte PNG file signature to the output stream managed by png_ptr.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct with output I/O configured.

functions.name: png_write_chunk
functions.signature: void png_write_chunk(png_struct *png_ptr, const png_byte *chunk_name, const png_byte *data, size_t length);
functions.description: Writes a complete PNG chunk given its 4-byte name, data pointer, and data length (handles length, type, data, and CRC).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct with output I/O configured.
chunk_name must point to 4 valid PNG chunk name bytes; no terminator is expected.
If length > 0, data must point to at least length bytes.

functions.name: png_write_chunk_start
functions.signature: void png_write_chunk_start(png_struct *png_ptr, const png_byte *chunk_name, png_uint_32 length);
functions.description: Begins writing a PNG chunk by outputting its length and 4-byte name; the caller should follow with png_write_chunk_data and finish with png_write_chunk_end.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct with output I/O configured.
chunk_name must point to 4 valid PNG chunk name bytes.
length is the number of data bytes to follow.

functions.name: png_write_chunk_data
functions.signature: void png_write_chunk_data(png_struct *png_ptr, const png_byte *data, size_t length);
functions.description: Writes data bytes for the PNG chunk previously started with png_write_chunk_start.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct and a chunk must have been started.
If length > 0, data must point to at least length bytes.
The total data length written across calls must match the length specified to png_write_chunk_start.

functions.name: png_write_chunk_end
functions.description: Finishes a chunk started with png_write_chunk_start by writing the CRC.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct and a chunk must have been started.

functions.name: png_create_info_struct
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a png_info structure associated with the given png_struct.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized png_struct.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: png_info_init_3
functions.description: Deprecated initializer that allowed creation/initialization of a png_info using the default allocator. Kept for backward compatibility.
requirements: info_ptr must be non-NULL and point to a png_info* variable to be initialized.
png_info_struct_size must be sizeof(png_info).
Deprecated: prefer png_create_info_struct.

functions.name: png_write_info_before_PLTE
functions.description: Writes necessary PNG header information before the PLTE chunk, based on fields in info_ptr.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct with output I/O configured.
info_ptr must be a valid, populated png_info with the relevant fields set for writing.

functions.name: png_write_info
functions.description: Writes all PNG header information prior to image data (including PLTE if present) using settings in info_ptr.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct with output I/O configured.
info_ptr must be a valid, populated png_info with the relevant fields set for writing.

functions.name: png_read_info
functions.description: Reads the PNG header and ancillary information before the image data and fills info_ptr with the parsed values.
requirements: Only available when PNG_SEQUENTIAL_READ_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct with input I/O configured.
info_ptr must be a valid png_info to receive header information.

functions.name: png_convert_to_rfc1123_buffer
functions.description: Converts a png_time to an RFC 1123 formatted ASCII string, writing into a fixed 29-byte buffer (including terminator). Returns non-zero on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: out must point to a buffer of at least 29 bytes.
ptime must be a valid pointer to a populated png_time.

functions.name: png_convert_from_struct_tm
functions.description: Converts a standard C struct tm into a png_time.
requirements: ptime must be a valid pointer to receive the result.
ttime must point to a valid struct tm.

functions.name: png_convert_from_time_t
functions.description: Converts a time_t (UTC via gmtime()) into a png_time.
requirements: ptime must be a valid pointer to receive the result.

functions.name: png_set_expand
functions.description: On read, expands palette images to RGB, grayscale images of bit depth 1,2,4 to 8-bit, and tRNS to alpha as needed.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_EXPAND_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_expand_gray_1_2_4_to_8
functions.description: On read, expands 1-, 2-, and 4-bit grayscale images to 8-bit samples.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_EXPAND_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_palette_to_rgb
functions.description: On read, forces palette images to be expanded to RGB.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_EXPAND_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_tRNS_to_alpha
functions.description: On read, expands tRNS transparency information to a full alpha channel.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_EXPAND_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_expand_16
functions.description: On read, expands all samples to 16-bit channels; also converts palette to RGB and expands tRNS if present.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_EXPAND_16_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_bgr
functions.description: Requests BGR/BGRA byte order instead of RGB/RGBA for pixel data.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_BGR_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_BGR_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate to the operation.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_gray_to_rgb
functions.description: On read, expands grayscale (with or without alpha) to RGB (or RGBA).
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_GRAY_TO_RGB_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_rgb_to_gray
functions.signature: void png_set_rgb_to_gray(png_struct *png_ptr, int error_action, double red, double green);
functions.description: On read, reduces RGB/RGBA to grayscale with optional coefficients and error action policy. Floating-point variant.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_RGB_TO_GRAY_SUPPORTED and PNG_FLOATING_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.
error_action must be one of PNG_ERROR_ACTION_NONE, PNG_ERROR_ACTION_WARN, or PNG_ERROR_ACTION_ERROR.

functions.name: png_set_rgb_to_gray_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_rgb_to_gray_fixed(png_struct *png_ptr, int error_action, png_fixed_point red, png_fixed_point green);
functions.description: Fixed-point variant of png_set_rgb_to_gray.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_RGB_TO_GRAY_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled.
png_ptr must be valid; call before updating info/starting read transforms.
error_action must be one of PNG_ERROR_ACTION_NONE, PNG_ERROR_ACTION_WARN, or PNG_ERROR_ACTION_ERROR.

functions.name: png_get_rgb_to_gray_status
functions.description: Returns status flags for the RGB-to-gray transform during reading.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_RGB_TO_GRAY_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.

functions.name: png_build_grayscale_palette
functions.description: Builds a grayscale palette (PLTE) for a given bit depth into the provided palette array.
requirements: Only available when PNG_BUILD_GRAYSCALE_PALETTE_SUPPORTED is enabled.
bit_depth should be a legal grayscale depth (typically 1, 2, 4, or 8).
palette must point to a buffer large enough to hold the required number of entries (up to 256).

functions.name: png_set_alpha_mode
functions.signature: void png_set_alpha_mode(png_struct *png_ptr, int mode, double output_gamma);
functions.description: Controls how libpng interprets and processes alpha on read (e.g., PNG, STANDARD/ASSOCIATED/PREMULTIPLIED, OPTIMIZED, BROKEN) and sets output gamma. Floating-point variant.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_ALPHA_MODE_SUPPORTED and PNG_FLOATING_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled (or when PNG_GAMMA_SUPPORTED for gamma interactions).
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.
mode must be one of PNG_ALPHA_PNG, PNG_ALPHA_STANDARD/ASSOCIATED/PREMULTIPLIED, PNG_ALPHA_OPTIMIZED, or PNG_ALPHA_BROKEN.

functions.name: png_set_alpha_mode_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_alpha_mode_fixed(png_struct *png_ptr, int mode, png_fixed_point output_gamma);
functions.description: Fixed-point variant of png_set_alpha_mode.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_ALPHA_MODE_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled (or when PNG_GAMMA_SUPPORTED for gamma interactions).
png_ptr must be valid; call before updating info/starting read transforms.
mode must be one of the PNG_ALPHA_* constants.

functions.name: png_set_strip_alpha
functions.description: On read, strips (removes) the alpha channel from the image.
requirements: Only available when PNG_READ_STRIP_ALPHA_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_swap_alpha
functions.description: Requests swapping of alpha byte order (e.g., ARGB <-> RGBA) during row processing.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_SWAP_ALPHA_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_SWAP_ALPHA_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_invert_alpha
functions.description: Requests bitwise inversion of the alpha channel during row processing.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_INVERT_ALPHA_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_INVERT_ALPHA_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_filler
functions.signature: void png_set_filler(png_struct *png_ptr, png_uint_32 filler, int flags);
functions.description: Adds a filler byte/word to grayscale or RGB images (e.g., to expand to GA/RGBA) with position controlled by flags.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_FILLER_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_FILLER_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.
flags must be PNG_FILLER_BEFORE or PNG_FILLER_AFTER.
For 8-bit or 16-bit images as documented; filler value is used as the added sample.

functions.name: png_set_add_alpha
functions.signature: void png_set_add_alpha(png_struct *png_ptr, png_uint_32 filler, int flags);
functions.description: Adds an alpha channel to grayscale or RGB images with the provided constant alpha value and position controlled by flags.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_FILLER_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_FILLER_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.
flags must be PNG_FILLER_BEFORE or PNG_FILLER_AFTER.
For 8-bit or 16-bit usages as documented; filler is used for the new alpha sample.

functions.name: png_set_swap
functions.description: Requests swapping of byte order within 16-bit samples during row processing.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_SWAP_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_SWAP_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_packing
functions.description: On read/write, unpacks 1, 2, or 4-bit per sample images to one byte per sample (8 bits).
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_PACK_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_PACK_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_packswap
functions.description: Swaps the packing order of sub-byte pixels within bytes (LSB/MSB first) during row processing.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_PACKSWAP_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_PACKSWAP_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_shift
functions.description: On read/write, shifts sample values to legal bit depths based on significant bits described by true_bits.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_SHIFT_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_SHIFT_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.
true_bits must point to a valid png_color_8 structure describing significant bits.

functions.name: png_set_interlace_handling
functions.description: Enables libpng Adam7 interlace handling and returns the number of passes (always 7 for Adam7). Must be called before png_read_update_info or png_start_read_image.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_INTERLACING_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_INTERLACING_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid.
Must be called before png_read_update_info or png_start_read_image for effect.

functions.name: png_set_invert_mono
functions.description: Inverts monochrome (1-bit) samples during row processing (black/white inversion).
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_INVERT_SUPPORTED or PNG_WRITE_INVERT_SUPPORTED is enabled as appropriate.
png_ptr must be valid; call before transforming rows.

functions.name: png_set_background
functions.signature: void png_set_background(png_struct *png_ptr, const png_color_16 *background_color, int background_gamma_code, int need_expand, double background_gamma);
functions.description: On read, composites image pixels against a specified background color to handle alpha and tRNS. Floating-point variant.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_BACKGROUND_SUPPORTED is enabled.
Prior to libpng-1.5.4 this API must not be called before the PNG file header has been read; doing so could cause unexpected behavior.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
background_color must point to a valid png_color_16.
background_gamma_code should be one of PNG_BACKGROUND_GAMMA_UNKNOWN, SCREEN, FILE, or UNIQUE.
need_expand indicates whether the background color needs expansion to the image bit depth.

functions.name: png_set_background_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_background_fixed(png_struct *png_ptr, const png_color_16 *background_color, int background_gamma_code, int need_expand, png_fixed_point background_gamma);
functions.description: Fixed-point variant of png_set_background.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_BACKGROUND_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled.
png_ptr must be valid; other requirements as for the floating-point variant.

functions.name: png_set_scale_16
functions.description: On read, accurately scales 16-bit samples down to 8-bit.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_SCALE_16_TO_8_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_strip_16
functions.description: On read, strips the low byte from 16-bit samples, effectively reducing to 8-bit by truncation.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_STRIP_16_TO_8_SUPPORTED (PNG_READ_16_TO_8_SUPPORTED) is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.

functions.name: png_set_quantize
functions.signature: void png_set_quantize(png_struct *png_ptr, png_color *palette, int num_palette, int maximum_colors, const png_uint_16 *histogram, int full_quantize);
functions.description: On read, enables palette quantization to reduce the number of colors to the requested maximum, optionally using a supplied palette and histogram.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_QUANTIZE_SUPPORTED is enabled.
png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct; call before updating info/starting read transforms.
palette must point to at least num_palette entries if supplied; maximum_colors specifies the target palette size.

functions.name: png_set_gamma
functions.signature: void png_set_gamma(png_struct *png_ptr, double screen_gamma, double override_file_gamma);
functions.description: Sets output screen gamma and (optionally) overrides file gamma for read processing. Floating-point variant.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_GAMMA_SUPPORTED and PNG_FLOATING_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled.
png_ptr must be valid; call before reading the file header for best results, otherwise it may override file gamma.
Values may be one of the PNG_GAMMA_* macros or PNG_DEFAULT_sRGB as documented.

functions.name: png_set_gamma_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_gamma_fixed(png_struct *png_ptr, png_fixed_point screen_gamma, png_fixed_point override_file_gamma);
functions.description: Fixed-point variant of png_set_gamma.
requirements: Available when PNG_READ_GAMMA_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED are enabled.
png_ptr must be valid; call before reading the file header for best results.

functions.name: png_set_flush
functions.description: Set the number of rows between output flushes during writing.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct.
nrows >= 0 (0 disables automatic flushing).

functions.name: png_write_flush
functions.description: Flush the current PNG output buffer during writing.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized write png_struct.
Custom write function should tolerate flush calls.

functions.name: png_start_read_image
functions.description: Optional pre-read step to update internal palettes/transforms before reading rows.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid, initialized read png_struct.
Must be called after header/info read (e.g., after png_read_info).

functions.name: png_read_update_info
functions.description: Apply pending transforms to update the info struct to reflect the output format that will be produced by row reading.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
info_ptr must point to an initialized png_info associated with png_ptr.
Should be called after setting desired transforms and before starting row reads.

functions.name: png_read_rows
functions.signature: void png_read_rows(png_struct *png_ptr, png_byte **row, png_byte **display_row, png_uint_32 num_rows)
functions.description: Read one or more rows of image data into row buffers (and optionally display rows).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct in sequential read mode.
row must point to an array of num_rows pointers to writable buffers sized for the current rowbytes.
If display_row is non-NULL, it must be an array of num_rows pointers to writable buffers.
Must be called num_rows times per pass for interlaced images as appropriate.

functions.name: png_read_row
functions.description: Read a single row of image data into the provided buffer, optionally also a display buffer.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
row must point to a writable buffer of at least png_get_rowbytes(png_ptr, info_ptr).
If display_row is non-NULL it must be a writable buffer of sufficient size.
Call exactly once per image row per pass.

functions.name: png_read_image
functions.description: Read the entire image into an array of row pointers.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct in sequential read mode.
image must be an array of pointers to writable row buffers covering all rows; each row buffer must be at least rowbytes in size.

functions.name: png_write_row
functions.description: Write a single row of image data to the PNG stream.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
row must point to a buffer containing the encoded row matching current IHDR and transform state.
Call exactly once per image row per pass.

functions.name: png_write_rows
functions.description: Write multiple rows of image data in sequence.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
row must be an array of num_rows pointers to row buffers.
Each row buffer must match the current output format.

functions.name: png_write_image
functions.description: Write the entire image using an array of row pointers.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct with IHDR and ancillary data set as needed.
image must be an array of row pointers covering height rows; each row must be a valid row buffer.

functions.name: png_write_end
functions.description: Finish writing the PNG stream and optionally write end info (e.g., tIME).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
If info_ptr is non-NULL it must be associated with png_ptr and contain any end-chunks to write.

functions.name: png_read_end
functions.description: Read the end of the PNG stream and update info_ptr with any end information.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct in sequential read mode.
info_ptr must be a valid png_info to receive end info (may be NULL to skip).

functions.name: png_destroy_info_struct
functions.description: Free memory associated with a png_info and set the pointer to NULL.
requirements: png_ptr must be the png_struct associated with the png_info.
info_ptr_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a png_info*; if *info_ptr_ptr is non-NULL it will be freed and set to NULL.
May be called at any time to release an info_struct.

functions.name: png_destroy_read_struct
functions.description: Free memory associated with the read png_struct and its info/end_info structs.
requirements: png_ptr_ptr must be non-NULL; if *png_ptr_ptr is non-NULL it will be destroyed and set to NULL.
info_ptr_ptr and end_info_ptr_ptr may be NULL; if provided, their targets will be freed and set to NULL if non-NULL.
Must not use the structs after calling.

functions.name: png_destroy_write_struct
functions.description: Free memory associated with the write png_struct and its info_struct.
requirements: png_ptr_ptr must be non-NULL; if *png_ptr_ptr is non-NULL it will be destroyed and set to NULL.
info_ptr_ptr may be NULL; if provided and *info_ptr_ptr is non-NULL it will be freed and set to NULL.

functions.name: png_set_crc_action
functions.signature: void png_set_crc_action(png_struct *png_ptr, int crit_action, int ancil_action)
functions.description: Control how libpng handles CRC errors for critical and ancillary chunks.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid png_struct.
crit_action and ancil_action must be one of PNG_CRC_* constants.

functions.name: png_set_filter
functions.signature: void png_set_filter(png_struct *png_ptr, int method, int filters)
functions.description: Select scanline filtering methods used during writing.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
method must currently be 0 (PNG base filter method).
filters is a bitmask of PNG_FILTER_* flags.

functions.name: png_set_compression_level
functions.description: Set zlib compression level for IDAT data.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED at build time.
level should be in 0..9 (mapped to zlib).

functions.name: png_set_compression_mem_level
functions.description: Set zlib memory level for IDAT compression.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.
mem_level typically 1..9 (zlib semantics).

functions.name: png_set_compression_strategy
functions.description: Set zlib strategy for IDAT compression.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.
strategy must be a valid zlib strategy constant (e.g., Z_DEFAULT_STRATEGY, etc.).

functions.name: png_set_compression_window_bits
functions.description: Set zlib window bits (LZ77 sliding window) for IDAT compression (libpng may optimize CMF if supported).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.
window_bits must be valid for zlib; libpng may clamp for safety.

functions.name: png_set_compression_method
functions.description: Set zlib compression method for IDAT compression (normally deflate method 8).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.
method must be a valid zlib method (usually Z_DEFLATED).

functions.name: png_set_text_compression_level
functions.description: Set zlib compression level for compressed text (non-IDAT) chunks.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_ZTXT_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.
level should be in 0..9 per zlib.

functions.name: png_set_text_compression_mem_level
functions.description: Set zlib memory level for compressed text chunks.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_ZTXT_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_set_text_compression_strategy
functions.description: Set zlib strategy for compressed text chunks.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_ZTXT_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_set_text_compression_window_bits
functions.description: Set zlib window bits for compressed text chunks (libpng may optimize CMF).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_ZTXT_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_set_text_compression_method
functions.description: Set zlib method for compressed text chunks (normally deflate).
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_CUSTOMIZE_ZTXT_COMPRESSION_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_init_io
functions.description: Initialize default stdio I/O for reading or writing using a FILE*.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Requires PNG_STDIO_SUPPORTED.
fp must be a valid open FILE* in the correct mode for the operation.

functions.name: png_set_error_fn
functions.signature: void png_set_error_fn(png_struct *png_ptr, void *error_ptr, png_error_ptr error_fn, png_error_ptr warning_fn)
functions.description: Install user-defined error and warning callbacks and associate a user pointer.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
If error_fn is NULL, default is used; same for warning_fn.
If using setjmp/longjmp, error_fn must longjmp or terminate as documented.

functions.name: png_get_error_ptr
functions.description: Return the user pointer associated with the error/warning callbacks.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_set_write_fn
functions.signature: void png_set_write_fn(png_struct *png_ptr, void *io_ptr, png_rw_ptr write_data_fn, png_flush_ptr output_flush_fn)
functions.description: Replace default write handlers with user-provided write and optional flush callbacks and set an I/O user pointer.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
write_data_fn must be non-NULL to handle output bytes.
output_flush_fn may be NULL (ignored if PNG_WRITE_FLUSH_SUPPORTED is not enabled).

functions.name: png_set_read_fn
functions.description: Replace default read handler with user-provided read callback and set an I/O user pointer.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
read_data_fn must be non-NULL.

functions.name: png_get_io_ptr
functions.description: Return the user I/O pointer set via png_set_read_fn/pnge_set_write_fn.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_set_read_status_fn
functions.description: Install a per-row status callback for reading.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
read_row_fn may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: png_set_write_status_fn
functions.description: Install a per-row status callback for writing.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
write_row_fn may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: png_set_mem_fn
functions.signature: void png_set_mem_fn(png_struct *png_ptr, void *mem_ptr, png_malloc_ptr malloc_fn, png_free_ptr free_fn)
functions.description: Install user-defined memory allocation and free functions and associated pointer.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Requires PNG_USER_MEM_SUPPORTED.
Both malloc_fn and free_fn should be provided to avoid mismatch.

functions.name: png_get_mem_ptr
functions.description: Return the user pointer set for memory functions.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Requires PNG_USER_MEM_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_set_read_user_transform_fn
functions.description: Set user row-transform callback to be invoked during reads.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
Requires PNG_READ_USER_TRANSFORM_SUPPORTED.
read_user_transform_fn may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: png_set_write_user_transform_fn
functions.description: Set user row-transform callback to be invoked during writes.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid write png_struct.
Requires PNG_WRITE_USER_TRANSFORM_SUPPORTED.
write_user_transform_fn may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: png_set_user_transform_info
functions.signature: void png_set_user_transform_info(png_struct *png_ptr, void *user_transform_ptr, int user_transform_depth, int user_transform_channels)
functions.description: Provide user transform context pointer and data format info for use by user transform callbacks.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Requires PNG_USER_TRANSFORM_PTR_SUPPORTED.
user_transform_depth and user_transform_channels should match the data handled by the callback.

functions.name: png_get_user_transform_ptr
functions.description: Return the user pointer associated with the user transform functions.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Requires PNG_USER_TRANSFORM_PTR_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_get_current_row_number
functions.description: Return the current (sub-image) row number being processed inside a user transform callback.
requirements: Call only within a user transform callback; outside usage may return unexpected results.
Requires PNG_USER_TRANSFORM_INFO_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_get_current_pass_number
functions.description: Return the current interlace pass number inside a user transform callback.
requirements: Call only within a user transform callback; outside usage may return unexpected results.
Requires PNG_USER_TRANSFORM_INFO_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_set_read_user_chunk_fn
functions.description: Install a callback to handle unknown (or configured-as-unknown) chunks during read and set its user pointer.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct.
Requires PNG_READ_USER_CHUNKS_SUPPORTED.
Callback return semantics must follow documentation (negative error; 0 not handled/save; positive handled/discard).

functions.name: png_get_user_chunk_ptr
functions.description: Return the user pointer associated with the user chunk callback.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Requires PNG_USER_CHUNKS_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_set_progressive_read_fn
functions.signature: void png_set_progressive_read_fn(png_struct *png_ptr, void *progressive_ptr, png_progressive_info_ptr info_fn, png_progressive_row_ptr row_fn, png_progressive_end_ptr end_fn)
functions.description: Set callbacks and user pointer for progressive (push) reading.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid read png_struct with progressive read enabled.
progressive_ptr is stored and returned by png_get_progressive_ptr.
Any of info_fn, row_fn, end_fn may be NULL to skip those notifications.

functions.name: png_get_progressive_ptr
functions.description: Return the user pointer associated with progressive read callbacks.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_process_data
functions.signature: void png_process_data(png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_byte *buffer, size_t buffer_size)
functions.description: Feed available input bytes to the progressive reader for processing; invokes installed callbacks as needed.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid progressive read png_struct.
info_ptr must be a valid png_info for this read.
buffer points to buffer_size bytes of new input.

functions.name: png_process_data_pause
functions.description: Pause progressive processing, returning the number of external bytes remaining to be re-supplied later. If save!=0, libpng saves pending data and returns 0.
requirements: Must be called only within png_process_data.
png_ptr must be a valid progressive read png_struct.

functions.name: png_process_data_skip
functions.description: Return number of input bytes to skip before resuming progressive processing (call only after returning from png_process_data).
requirements: Must be called only outside/after a png_process_data call.
png_ptr must be a valid progressive read png_struct.

functions.name: png_progressive_combine_row
functions.signature: void png_progressive_combine_row(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_byte *old_row, const png_byte *new_row)
functions.description: Combine an interlaced row update into an existing output row buffer.
requirements: png_ptr must be a valid progressive read png_struct.
old_row must point to the destination row buffer.
new_row is ignored unless there is new data per callback indication.

functions.name: png_malloc
functions.description: Allocate memory via libpng allocator; may invoke user-provided allocator if set.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
size must be > 0 and within libpng/user limits; may error/abort on failure depending on error handling.

functions.name: png_calloc
functions.description: Allocate zero-initialized memory via libpng allocator.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
size must be > 0 and within limits.

functions.name: png_malloc_warn
functions.description: Allocate memory, but return NULL on failure instead of triggering a libpng error.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Caller must check the return value for NULL.

functions.name: png_free
functions.description: Free memory previously allocated by png_malloc/calloc/malloc_warn (or user allocator).
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
ptr may be NULL (no-op).

functions.name: png_free_data
functions.signature: void png_free_data(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 free_me, int num)
functions.description: Free libpng-allocated data referenced by png_info according to a mask and count, and clear corresponding valid flags.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
info_ptr must be a valid png_info from the same context.
free_me is a bitmask of PNG_FREE_* flags; num may control how many entries to free for some types.

functions.name: png_data_freer
functions.signature: void png_data_freer(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int freer, png_uint_32 mask)
functions.description: Reassign which party (libpng or user) is responsible for freeing specific data in png_info.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
info_ptr must be valid.
freer must be one of PNG_DESTROY_WILL_FREE_DATA or PNG_USER_WILL_FREE_DATA.
mask is a combination of PNG_FREE_* flags.

functions.name: png_malloc_default
functions.description: Deprecated: default allocator entry point (use png_malloc).
requirements: Deprecated; avoid use.

functions.name: png_free_default
functions.description: Deprecated: default free entry point (use png_free).
requirements: Deprecated; avoid use.

functions.name: png_error
functions.description: Raise a fatal libpng error; does not return. Typically triggers longjmp via installed error handler or aborts.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid (may be NULL for some builds, but not recommended).
Does not return; caller must not continue execution.

functions.name: png_chunk_error
functions.description: Raise a fatal error but with the current chunk name prepended to the message; does not return.
requirements: Same as png_error.
Used typically during chunk processing.

functions.name: png_err
functions.description: When PNG_ERROR_TEXT_SUPPORTED is disabled, this is the fatal error function; does not return.
requirements: Only available when error text is disabled (png_error/pgn_chunk_error macro to this).
Does not return.

functions.name: png_warning
functions.description: Emit a non-fatal libpng warning via the installed warning handler.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid (may be NULL-safe by implementation).

functions.name: png_chunk_warning
functions.description: Emit a non-fatal warning with the current chunk name prepended.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_benign_error
functions.description: Emit a benign warning (or error depending on configuration) that allows processing to continue.
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Behavior depends on png_set_benign_errors setting.

functions.name: png_chunk_benign_error
functions.description: Emit a benign warning with the chunk name prepended (read paths only).
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.
Only available during read builds.

functions.name: png_set_benign_errors
functions.description: Configure whether benign errors are treated as warnings (allowed!=0) or fatal (allowed==0).
requirements: png_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_valid
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_valid(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 flag)
functions.description: Return non-zero (flag) if specified info flag(s) are valid in info_ptr.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
flag is a PNG_INFO_* mask.

functions.name: png_get_rowbytes
functions.description: Return the number of bytes in a row given current transforms and info.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_rows
functions.description: Return the row pointers array set by png_read_png().
requirements: Requires PNG_INFO_IMAGE_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
Only meaningful if rows were set in info.

functions.name: png_set_rows
functions.description: Set the row pointers array for use by png_write_png().
requirements: Requires PNG_INFO_IMAGE_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
row_pointers must point to height row buffers of sufficient size.

functions.name: png_get_channels
functions.description: Return the number of color channels in the image given current info.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_image_width
functions.description: Return image width in pixels.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_image_height
functions.description: Return image height in pixels.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_bit_depth
functions.description: Return image bit depth.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_color_type
functions.description: Return image color type (PNG_COLOR_TYPE_*).
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_filter_type
functions.description: Return image filter method from IHDR.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_interlace_type
functions.description: Return interlace method (PNG_INTERLACE_*).
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_compression_type
functions.description: Return compression method from IHDR.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_pixels_per_meter
functions.description: Return pixels-per-meter (X or both) from pHYs; convenience.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_x_pixels_per_meter
functions.description: Return X pixels-per-meter from pHYs.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_y_pixels_per_meter
functions.description: Return Y pixels-per-meter from pHYs.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_pixel_aspect_ratio
functions.description: Return pixel aspect ratio computed from pHYs.
requirements: Requires floating-point support enabled.
png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
Returns 0 if unavailable.

functions.name: png_get_pixel_aspect_ratio_fixed
functions.description: Return pixel aspect ratio in fixed-point.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_x_offset_pixels
functions.description: Return X offset in pixels from oFFs.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_y_offset_pixels
functions.description: Return Y offset in pixels from oFFs.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_x_offset_microns
functions.description: Return X offset in micrometers from oFFs.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_y_offset_microns
functions.description: Return Y offset in micrometers from oFFs.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_signature
functions.signature: const png_byte * png_get_signature(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr)
functions.description: Return pointer to the 8-byte signature read from the PNG header.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
Only defined for read paths.

functions.name: png_get_bKGD
functions.description: Get bKGD chunk data and return PNG_INFO_bKGD if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
background must be a pointer to receive a pointer owned by libpng; do not modify.

functions.name: png_set_bKGD
functions.signature: void png_set_bKGD(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_color_16 *background)
functions.description: Set bKGD chunk data to write or store in info.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
background must point to a valid png_color_16 struct.

functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cHRM(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, double *white_x, double *white_y, double *red_x, double *red_y, double *green_x, double *green_y, double *blue_x, double *blue_y)
functions.description: Get cHRM chromaticities as doubles; returns PNG_INFO_cHRM if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_cHRM_XYZ
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cHRM_XYZ(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, double *red_X, double *red_Y, double *red_Z, double *green_X, double *green_Y, double *green_Z, double *blue_X, double *blue_Y, double *blue_Z)
functions.description: Get cHRM values converted to XYZ as doubles; returns PNG_INFO_cHRM if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cHRM_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point *int_white_x, png_fixed_point *int_white_y, png_fixed_point *int_red_x, png_fixed_point *int_red_y, png_fixed_point *int_green_x, png_fixed_point *int_green_y, png_fixed_point *int_blue_x, png_fixed_point *int_blue_y)
functions.description: Get cHRM chromaticities as fixed-point; returns PNG_INFO_cHRM if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_cHRM_XYZ_fixed
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cHRM_XYZ_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point *int_red_X, png_fixed_point *int_red_Y, png_fixed_point *int_red_Z, png_fixed_point *int_green_X, png_fixed_point *int_green_Y, png_fixed_point *int_green_Z, png_fixed_point *int_blue_X, png_fixed_point *int_blue_Y, png_fixed_point *int_blue_Z)
functions.description: Get cHRM values converted to XYZ as fixed-point; returns PNG_INFO_cHRM if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.signature: void png_set_cHRM(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, double white_x, double white_y, double red_x, double red_y, double green_x, double green_y, double blue_x, double blue_y)
functions.description: Set cHRM chromaticities (floating point) into info for writing.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
Values should be within the valid range per PNG spec.

functions.name: png_set_cHRM_XYZ

functions.description: Set cHRM values as XYZ (floating point).
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.description: Set cHRM chromaticities as fixed-point.

functions.signature: void png_set_cHRM_XYZ_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point int_red_X, png_fixed_point int_red_Y, png_fixed_point int_red_Z, png_fixed_point int_green_X, png_fixed_point int_green_Y, png_fixed_point int_green_Z, png_fixed_point int_blue_X, png_fixed_point int_blue_Y, png_fixed_point int_blue_Z)
