functions.name: png_get_cICP
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cICP(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_byte *colour_primaries, png_byte *transfer_function, png_byte *matrix_coefficients, png_byte *video_full_range_flag)
functions.description: Get cICP chunk fields; returns PNG_INFO_cICP if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
Any output parameter may be NULL if not needed.

functions.name: png_set_cICP
functions.signature: void png_set_cICP(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_byte colour_primaries, png_byte transfer_function, png_byte matrix_coefficients, png_byte video_full_range_flag)
functions.description: Set cICP chunk values in info for writing.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
Values must be valid per cICP spec.

functions.name: png_get_cLLI
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cLLI(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, double *maximum_content_light_level, double *maximum_frame_average_light_level)
functions.description: Get cLLI (content light level) as doubles; returns PNG_INFO_cLLI if present.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_cLLI_fixed
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_cLLI_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 *maximum_content_light_level_scaled_by_10000, png_uint_32 *maximum_frame_average_light_level_scaled_by_10000)
functions.description: Get cLLI values scaled by 10,000 (unsigned integers).
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_set_cLLI
functions.signature: void png_set_cLLI(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, double maximum_content_light_level, double maximum_frame_average_light_level)
functions.description: Set cLLI values (doubles) for writing.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_set_cLLI_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_cLLI_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 maximum_content_light_level_scaled_by_10000, png_uint_32 maximum_frame_average_light_level_scaled_by_10000)
functions.description: Set cLLI values scaled by 10,000 for writing.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.

functions.name: png_get_eXIf_1
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_eXIf_1(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 *num_exif, png_byte **exif)
functions.description: Get eXIf data; returns PNG_INFO_eXIf if present and fills count and pointer.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
exif is a pointer to internal memory; do not modify or free.

functions.name: png_set_eXIf_1
functions.signature: void png_set_eXIf_1(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 num_exif, png_byte *exif)
functions.description: Set eXIf data (tag stream) for writing.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid.
exif must point to num_exif bytes containing the Exif APP1 payload.

functions.name: png_get_gAMA
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_gAMA(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, double *file_gamma)
functions.description: Get the image gamma (gAMA chunk) as a floating-point value.
requirements: png_ptr and info_ptr must be valid libpng structures created/filled by libpng.
Returns non-zero if gAMA info is present (PNG_INFO_gAMA), otherwise returns 0 and does not modify file_gamma.
Call after the PNG header/ancillary chunks are read (e.g., after png_read_info).
Requires PNG_gAMA_SUPPORTED at build time.

functions.name: png_get_gAMA_fixed
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_gAMA_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point *int_file_gamma)
functions.description: Get the image gamma (gAMA chunk) as a fixed-point value (scaled by 100,000).
requirements: Same as png_get_gAMA; returns non-zero if available.
Requires PNG_gAMA_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED at build time.

functions.name: png_set_gAMA
functions.signature: void png_set_gAMA(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, double file_gamma)
functions.description: Set the image gamma (gAMA) in the info struct using a floating-point value.
requirements: png_ptr/info_ptr must be valid and for a write or for modifying info prior to writing.
Requires PNG_gAMA_SUPPORTED.
file_gamma should be a positive value; libpng will validate/encode as needed before writing.

functions.name: png_set_gAMA_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_gAMA_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point int_file_gamma)
functions.description: Set the image gamma (gAMA) using a fixed-point value scaled by 100,000.
requirements: Same as png_set_gAMA; requires PNG_gAMA_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED.
int_file_gamma must be a non-negative fixed-point value representable in png_fixed_point.

functions.name: png_get_hIST
functions.description: Get the histogram (hIST chunk) of palette frequency counts.
requirements: png_ptr/info_ptr must be valid; image must have a PLTE palette.
Returns non-zero if hIST is present; on success sets *hist to an array of num_palette 16-bit values owned by libpng.
Requires PNG_hIST_SUPPORTED.
Call after header/info read.

functions.name: png_set_hIST
functions.signature: void png_set_hIST(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_uint_16 *hist)
functions.description: Set the hIST histogram (palette frequency) values in info for writing.
requirements: png_ptr/info_ptr valid; a PLTE palette must be present in info with num_palette entries; hist must point to at least num_palette png_uint_16 values.
Requires PNG_hIST_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: png_get_IHDR
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_IHDR(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 *width, png_uint_32 *height, int *bit_depth, int *color_type, int *interlace_method, int *compression_method, int *filter_method)
functions.description: Retrieve the fundamental IHDR fields (size, depth, color type, interlace, etc.).
requirements: png_ptr/info_ptr valid and populated (typically after png_read_info).
Any output pointer may be NULL if the caller does not need that field.
Returns non-zero if IHDR is available.

functions.name: png_set_IHDR
functions.signature: void png_set_IHDR(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 width, png_uint_32 height, int bit_depth, int color_type, int interlace_method, int compression_method, int filter_method)
functions.description: Set IHDR fields in the info struct prior to writing.
requirements: png_ptr/info_ptr valid.
width and height must be within libpng user limits (png_set_user_limits or defaults).

bit_depth must be a valid PNG depth (1,2,4,8,16) per color_type; color_type must be a valid PNG color type constant; interlace_method must be PNG_INTERLACE_NONE or PNG_INTERLACE_ADAM7; compression_method/filter_method must be the PNG base values (0).

functions.name: png_get_mDCV
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_mDCV(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, double *white_x, double *white_y, double *red_x, double *red_y, double *green_x, double *green_y, double *blue_x, double *blue_y, double *mastering_display_maximum_luminance, double *mastering_display_minimum_luminance)
functions.description: Get the mastering display color volume (mDCV) chunk values: display primaries/white point chromaticities and mastering luminance, as floating point.
requirements: Requires PNG_mDCV_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid and populated; returns non-zero if the mDCV info is present.
Each output pointer may be NULL if not needed.

functions.name: png_get_mDCV_fixed
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_mDCV_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point *int_white_x, png_fixed_point *int_white_y, png_fixed_point *int_red_x, png_fixed_point *int_red_y, png_fixed_point *int_green_x, png_fixed_point *int_green_y, png_fixed_point *int_blue_x, png_fixed_point *int_blue_y, png_uint_32 *mastering_display_maximum_luminance_scaled_by_10000, png_uint_32 *mastering_display_minimum_luminance_scaled_by_10000)
functions.description: Get the mDCV values as fixed-point (chromaticities) and scaled integers for luminance (scaled by 10,000).
requirements: Requires PNG_mDCV_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED (chromaticity components use png_fixed_point).
Returns non-zero if present; output pointers may be NULL individually.

functions.name: png_set_mDCV
functions.signature: void png_set_mDCV(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, double white_x, double white_y, double red_x, double red_y, double green_x, double green_y, double blue_x, double blue_y, double mastering_display_maximum_luminance, double mastering_display_minimum_luminance)
functions.description: Set the mastering display color volume (mDCV) values using floating point.
requirements: Requires PNG_mDCV_SUPPORTED.
Chromaticity values must be within PNG’s admissible range (0..~1.31).
Luminance values are in cd/m² (nits).
png_ptr/info_ptr valid prior to writing.

functions.name: png_set_mDCV_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_mDCV_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_fixed_point int_white_x, png_fixed_point int_white_y, png_fixed_point int_red_x, png_fixed_point int_red_y, png_fixed_point int_green_x, png_fixed_point int_green_y, png_fixed_point int_blue_x, png_fixed_point int_blue_y, png_uint_32 mastering_display_maximum_luminance_scaled_by_10000, png_uint_32 mastering_display_minimum_luminance_scaled_by_10000)
functions.description: Set the mDCV values using fixed-point chromaticities and 31-bit unsigned luminance values scaled by 10,000.
requirements: Requires PNG_mDCV_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED.
Chromaticities must be non-negative and within PNG fixed-point range (about 0..1.3).
Luminance scaled values must fit in 31-bit unsigned (MSB zero).

functions.name: png_get_oFFs
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_oFFs(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_int_32 *offset_x, png_int_32 *offset_y, int *unit_type)
functions.description: Get image pixel offset (oFFs) in pixels or micrometers.
requirements: Requires PNG_oFFs_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; output pointers may be NULL individually.
unit_type is one of PNG_OFFSET_PIXEL or PNG_OFFSET_MICROMETER.

functions.name: png_set_oFFs
functions.signature: void png_set_oFFs(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_int_32 offset_x, png_int_32 offset_y, int unit_type)
functions.description: Set image pixel offset (oFFs) prior to writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_oFFs_SUPPORTED.
unit_type must be PNG_OFFSET_PIXEL or PNG_OFFSET_MICROMETER.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid prior to writing.

functions.name: png_get_pCAL
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_pCAL(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, char **purpose, png_int_32 *X0, png_int_32 *X1, int *type, int *nparams, char **units, char ***params)
functions.description: Get pCAL (pixel calibration) chunk information.
requirements: Requires PNG_pCAL_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; output pointers must be valid storage for receiving pointers to libpng-owned strings/arrays (do not modify).
Call after info read.

functions.name: png_set_pCAL
functions.signature: void png_set_pCAL(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const char *purpose, png_int_32 X0, png_int_32 X1, int type, int nparams, const char *units, char **params)
functions.description: Set pCAL (pixel calibration) chunk information for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_pCAL_SUPPORTED.
purpose and units are C strings; params points to nparams strings.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid prior to writing.

functions.name: png_get_pHYs
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_pHYs(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 *res_x, png_uint_32 *res_y, int *unit_type)
functions.description: Get pixels-per-unit (pHYs) resolution values and unit type.
requirements: Requires PNG_pHYs_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; unit_type is PNG_RESOLUTION_UNKNOWN or PNG_RESOLUTION_METER.

functions.name: png_set_pHYs
functions.signature: void png_set_pHYs(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_uint_32 res_x, png_uint_32 res_y, int unit_type)
functions.description: Set pHYs resolution and unit type for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_pHYs_SUPPORTED.
unit_type must be PNG_RESOLUTION_UNKNOWN or PNG_RESOLUTION_METER.
res_x/res_y are pixels per unit (meters if unit is METER).

functions.name: png_get_PLTE
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_PLTE(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_color **palette, int *num_palette)
functions.description: Get the PLTE palette pointer and number of entries.
requirements: Returns non-zero if PLTE is present; on success sets *palette to libpng-owned array and *num_palette to count.
Call after reading header/info.

functions.name: png_set_PLTE
functions.signature: void png_set_PLTE(png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_color *palette, int num_palette)
functions.description: Set the PLTE palette for writing.
requirements: palette must point to at most PNG_MAX_PALETTE_LENGTH entries; num_palette in 1..256.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid.
Typically required for indexed-color images.

functions.name: png_get_sBIT
functions.description: Get significant bits (sBIT) information.
requirements: Requires PNG_sBIT_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; sets *sig_bit to libpng-owned png_color_8 struct.

functions.name: png_set_sBIT
functions.signature: void png_set_sBIT(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_color_8 *sig_bit)
functions.description: Set sBIT significant bits info for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_sBIT_SUPPORTED.
sig_bit fields must be valid for the image color type.

functions.name: png_get_sRGB
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_sRGB(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, int *file_srgb_intent)
functions.description: Get sRGB rendering intent from sRGB chunk.
requirements: Requires PNG_sRGB_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; on success sets *file_srgb_intent to PNG_sRGB_INTENT_*.

functions.name: png_set_sRGB
functions.signature: void png_set_sRGB(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int srgb_intent)
functions.description: Set sRGB intent and mark image as sRGB.
requirements: Requires PNG_sRGB_SUPPORTED.
srgb_intent must be one of PNG_sRGB_INTENT_* constants.

functions.name: png_set_sRGB_gAMA_and_cHRM
functions.signature: void png_set_sRGB_gAMA_and_cHRM(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int srgb_intent)
functions.description: Set sRGB intent and also set gAMA and cHRM values to the sRGB standard values.
requirements: Requires PNG_sRGB_SUPPORTED.
srgb_intent must be PNG_sRGB_INTENT_*.

functions.name: png_get_iCCP
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_iCCP(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, char **name, int *compression_type, png_byte **profile, png_uint_32 *proflen)
functions.description: Get embedded ICC profile (iCCP) metadata: name, compression type, profile data and size.
requirements: Requires PNG_iCCP_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; output pointers receive libpng-managed memory (do not modify/free).

functions.name: png_set_iCCP
functions.signature: void png_set_iCCP(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const char *name, int compression_type, const png_byte *profile, png_uint_32 proflen)
functions.description: Set embedded ICC profile (iCCP) in info for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_iCCP_SUPPORTED.
name is a keyword (1-79 chars).
compression_type is typically PNG_COMPRESSION_TYPE_BASE.
profile/proflen specify the ICC profile bytes.

functions.name: png_get_sPLT
functions.description: Get sPLT (suggested palette) chunk entries.
requirements: Requires PNG_sPLT_SUPPORTED.
Returns the number of sPLT palettes; on success sets *entries to an array of that many png_sPLT_t entries (libpng-managed).

functions.name: png_set_sPLT
functions.signature: void png_set_sPLT(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_sPLT_t *entries, int nentries)
functions.description: Set sPLT (suggested palettes) for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_sPLT_SUPPORTED.
entries points to nentries png_sPLT_t entries.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid.

functions.name: png_get_text
functions.signature: int png_get_text(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_text **text_ptr, int *num_text)
functions.description: Get textual metadata (tEXt/zTXt/iTXt) entries.
requirements: Requires PNG_TEXT_SUPPORTED.
Returns the number of text chunks; sets *text_ptr to an array and *num_text to the count; strings are zero-terminated and libpng-managed.

functions.name: png_set_text
functions.signature: void png_set_text(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_text *text_ptr, int num_text)
functions.description: Set textual metadata entries for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_TEXT_SUPPORTED.
text_ptr points to num_text png_text structs; fields must follow rules (keyword 1-79 chars, compression values per docs).

functions.name: png_get_tIME
functions.description: Get last-modification time (tIME chunk).
requirements: Requires PNG_tIME_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; sets *mod_time to libpng-owned png_time.

functions.name: png_set_tIME
functions.signature: void png_set_tIME(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_time *mod_time)
functions.description: Set tIME (modification time) for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_tIME_SUPPORTED.
mod_time fields must be valid date/time values.

functions.name: png_get_tRNS
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_tRNS(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, png_byte **trans_alpha, int *num_trans, png_color_16 **trans_color)
functions.description: Get transparency information (tRNS) for palette or truecolor/gray images.
requirements: Requires PNG_tRNS_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; sets trans_alpha/num_trans for palette tRNS; sets trans_color for non-palette tRNS (libpng-owned).

functions.name: png_set_tRNS
functions.signature: void png_set_tRNS(png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_byte *trans_alpha, int num_trans, const png_color_16 *trans_color)
functions.description: Set tRNS transparency for writing.
requirements: Requires PNG_tRNS_SUPPORTED.
For palette images provide trans_alpha and num_trans; for non-palette provide trans_color.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid; PLTE must be set for palette case.

functions.name: png_get_sCAL
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_sCAL(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, int *unit, double *width, double *height)
functions.description: Get physical scale (sCAL) as floating point width/height and unit.
requirements: Requires PNG_sCAL_SUPPORTED and floating-point support at build (per comment).
Returns non-zero if present; unit is PNG_SCALE_*; width/height are positive.

functions.name: png_get_sCAL_fixed
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_sCAL_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, int *unit, png_fixed_point *width, png_fixed_point *height)
functions.description: Get sCAL as fixed-point values.
requirements: Requires PNG_sCAL_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED (and/or floating arithmetic per comment).
Returns non-zero if present.

functions.name: png_get_sCAL_s
functions.signature: png_uint_32 png_get_sCAL_s(const png_struct *png_ptr, const png_info *info_ptr, int *unit, char **swidth, char **sheight)
functions.description: Get sCAL values as strings (ASCII).
requirements: Requires PNG_sCAL_SUPPORTED.
Returns non-zero if present; swidth/sheight are libpng-managed strings.

functions.name: png_set_sCAL
functions.signature: void png_set_sCAL(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int unit, double width, double height)
functions.description: Set sCAL using floating-point width/height and unit.
requirements: Requires PNG_sCAL_SUPPORTED.
unit must be PNG_SCALE_*; width/height must be positive and representable.

functions.name: png_set_sCAL_fixed
functions.signature: void png_set_sCAL_fixed(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int unit, png_fixed_point width, png_fixed_point height)
functions.description: Set sCAL using fixed-point width/height.
requirements: Requires PNG_sCAL_SUPPORTED and PNG_FIXED_POINT_SUPPORTED.
unit must be PNG_SCALE_*; values must be non-negative and representable.

functions.name: png_set_sCAL_s
functions.signature: void png_set_sCAL_s(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int unit, const char *swidth, const char *sheight)
functions.description: Set sCAL using string representations of width/height and the unit.
requirements: Requires PNG_sCAL_SUPPORTED.
swidth/sheight are C strings representing positive values; unit is PNG_SCALE_*.

functions.name: png_set_keep_unknown_chunks
functions.signature: void png_set_keep_unknown_chunks(png_struct *png_ptr, int keep, const png_byte *chunk_list, int num_chunks)
functions.description: Control default and per-chunk handling of unknown (and, optionally, known) chunks on read/write.
requirements: Requires PNG_SET_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS_SUPPORTED and PNG_HANDLE_AS_UNKNOWN_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr valid.

keep must be one of PNG_HANDLE_CHUNK_* constants; num_chunks>0 applies to the provided chunk_list; num_chunks==0 sets default behavior; num_chunks<0 applies to all unknown and most known chunks (IHDR/PLTE/tRNS/IDAT/IEND excluded).
On read, behavior interacts with user chunk callbacks as documented.

functions.name: png_handle_as_unknown
functions.description: Query the keep behavior (PNG_HANDLE_CHUNK_*) for a specific chunk name.
requirements: png_ptr valid; chunk_name points to 4-byte ASCII name.
Returns non-zero when special handling is required (per-chunk override).

functions.name: png_set_unknown_chunks
functions.signature: void png_set_unknown_chunks(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, const png_unknown_chunk *unknowns, int num_unknowns)
functions.description: Provide unknown chunks to be written at appropriate positions.
requirements: Requires PNG_STORE_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS_SUPPORTED.
Each png_unknown_chunk has name (5th byte 0), data pointer, size; on write set 'location' per-chunk using png_set_unknown_chunk_location.
png_ptr/info_ptr valid.

functions.name: png_set_unknown_chunk_location
functions.signature: void png_set_unknown_chunk_location(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int chunk, int location)
functions.description: Set the location field for a previously added unknown chunk (by index) to control where it is written.
requirements: Requires PNG_STORE_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS_SUPPORTED.
chunk is the index into the unknown chunks list; location is a PNG_HAVE_* or PNG_AFTER_IDAT flag as appropriate.

functions.name: png_get_unknown_chunks
functions.description: Get the list of stored unknown chunks for read or write.
requirements: Requires PNG_STORE_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS_SUPPORTED.
Returns number of unknown chunks; on success sets *entries to an array of that many png_unknown_chunk (libpng-managed).

functions.name: png_set_invalid
functions.signature: void png_set_invalid(const png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int mask)
functions.description: Clear validity flags in info_ptr for chunks selected by mask (PNG_INFO_*).
requirements: png_ptr/info_ptr valid; use when your application frees or invalidates data so libpng stops considering it valid.

functions.name: png_read_png
functions.signature: void png_read_png(png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int transforms, void *params)
functions.description: High-level helper to read an entire PNG, applying requested transforms, and populate info/image rows.
requirements: Requires PNG_INFO_IMAGE_SUPPORTED and PNG_SEQUENTIAL_READ_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr/info_ptr must be initialized and I/O set; transforms is a bitmask of PNG_TRANSFORM_* flags; params is currently unused (must be NULL).

functions.name: png_write_png
functions.signature: void png_write_png(png_struct *png_ptr, png_info *info_ptr, int transforms, void *params)
functions.description: High-level helper to write an entire PNG, applying requested transforms, using info/rows.
requirements: Requires PNG_INFO_IMAGE_SUPPORTED and PNG_WRITE_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr/info_ptr must be initialized and populated; set rows via png_set_rows; transforms is a bitmask of PNG_TRANSFORM_*; params unused (NULL).

functions.name: png_get_copyright
functions.description: Return a static copyright/license string for libpng.
requirements: png_ptr may be NULL per example usage in comments; returned pointer is to a constant string and must not be freed.

functions.name: png_get_header_ver
functions.description: Return the version string for the libpng headers used at compile time.
requirements: png_ptr may be NULL.
Returns pointer to static string; do not free.

functions.name: png_get_header_version
functions.description: Same as png_get_header_ver (backward-compatible name).
requirements: png_ptr may be NULL; returns static string.

functions.name: png_get_libpng_ver
functions.description: Return the version string for the linked libpng library.
requirements: png_ptr may be NULL; returns static string.

functions.name: png_permit_mng_features
functions.description: Enable/disable MNG-related features (legacy).
requirements: Requires PNG_MNG_FEATURES_SUPPORTED.
png_ptr valid; mng_features_permitted is a bitmask.

functions.name: png_image_finish_read
functions.signature: int png_image_finish_read(png_image *image, const png_color *background, void *buffer, png_int_32 row_stride, void *colormap)
functions.description: Simplified API: finish reading image pixels (and optional colormap) into caller-provided buffers, applying format/transform as per image->format.
requirements: Requires PNG_SIMPLIFIED_READ_SUPPORTED.
image must have been successfully initialized by a png_image_begin_read_from_* call and image->format set by the caller.
buffer must have at least PNG_IMAGE_SIZE(image) bytes (or per row_stride) in the chosen format; row_stride in component units (1 or 2); negative stride indicates bottom-up.
If removing alpha into 8-bit colormap output, background must be supplied per rules; otherwise may be NULL.
If PNG_FORMAT_FLAG_COLORMAP set, colormap must be provided with at least PNG_IMAGE_COLORMAP_SIZE(image) bytes; image->colormap_entries will be updated.

functions.name: png_image_free

requirements: Requires PNG_SIMPLIFIED_WRITE_SUPPORTED and PNG_SIMPLIFIED_WRITE_STDIO_SUPPORTED.

buffer contains image data; if format is colormap, provide colormap with image->colormap_entries entries.
row_stride is in component units (1 or 2); 0 lets libpng compute; negative indicates bottom-up.
If convert_to_8_bit!=0 and format is linear 16-bit, output will be 8-bit sRGB-encoded.

functions.description: Simplified API: write image to a caller-supplied memory buffer (or query required size if memory==NULL).

import random
import struct
import zlib

# We generate valid, interesting arbitrary binary buffers targeted to the given
# libpng fuzz stubs. These stubs mainly consume:
# - Arbitrary byte strings for: png_sig_cmp, integer reader helpers, warning messages
# - 4-byte chunk names for write_chunk/_data
# - Small payloads for chunks (unknown, eXIf, iCCP)
# - Filenames are handled by the harness; we only provide the primary FUZZ_PARAM_STR buffer.
#
# Strategy:
# - With weighted choices, produce:
#   1) Exact PNG signature or variants with valid prefixes (to exercise png_sig_cmp with different num_to_check)
#   2) Valid 4-byte PNG chunk type names (mix critical/ancillary, safe/unsafe-to-copy)
#   3) Compact valid PNG files (1x1 images) to be used as payload bytes if the harness later writes them out
#   4) Small, well-formed EXIF header blobs
#   5) Small ICC profile-like blobs (not validated, but structured and non-empty)
#   6) Generic printable or binary buffers of varying sizes
# - Keep sizes <= 1024 typically, and always <= 4096.
# - Seeded randomness for reproducibility per call.

PNG_SIGNATURE = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"

# Some valid/interesting chunk type names (4 ASCII letters A-Z a-z) with bit semantics:
# Critical examples: IHDR, PLTE, IDAT, IEND
# Ancillary examples: tEXt, zTXt, iTXt, sRGB, gAMA, cHRM, iCCP, eXIf, pHYs, sBIT
CHUNK_NAMES = [
    b"IHDR", b"PLTE", b"IDAT", b"IEND",
    b"tEXt", b"zTXt", b"iTXt", b"sRGB", b"gAMA", b"cHRM", b"iCCP", b"eXIf",
    b"pHYs", b"sBIT", b"bKGD", b"tRNS", b"hIST", b"sPLT",
    b"acTL", b"fcTL", b"fdAT",  # APNG-related
]

PRINTABLES = bytes([c for c in range(32, 127)])

def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))

def _random_printable(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.choice(PRINTABLES) for _ in range(n))

def _random_chunk_name(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        return rng.choice(CHUNK_NAMES)
    # Generate arbitrary valid name (A-Za-z)
    def rand_letter():
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            return rng.randrange(65, 91)  # A-Z
        return rng.randrange(97, 123)     # a-z
    return bytes([rand_letter(), rand_letter(), rand_letter(), rand_letter()])

def _build_png_chunk(name: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    assert len(name) == 4
    length = struct.pack(">I", len(data))
    ctype = name
    crc = zlib.crc32(ctype)
    crc = zlib.crc32(data, crc)
    crc &= 0xffffffff
    return length + ctype + data + struct.pack(">I", crc)

def _build_minimal_png(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Build a valid minimal PNG with 1x1 pixel. Randomize color type a bit.
    width, height = 1, 1
    bit_depth = 8
    color_type = rng.choice([2, 6])  # Truecolor RGB or RGBA for simplicity
    compression = 0
    filter_method = 0
    interlace = rng.choice([0, 1])  # none or Adam7
    ihdr = struct.pack(
        ">IIBBBBB",
        width, height, bit_depth, color_type, compression, filter_method, interlace
    )
    ihdr_chunk = _build_png_chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr)

    # One row: filter byte 0 + pixel bytes
    channels = {0:1,2:3,3:1,4:2,6:4}[color_type]
    row = bytes([0]) + _rand_bytes(rng, channels)
    idat_data = zlib.compress(row, level=6)
    idat_chunk = _build_png_chunk(b"IDAT", idat_data)

    # Optionally add a small text or sRGB/iCCP chunk
    ancillary = b""
    roll = rng.random()
    if roll < 0.2:
        # tEXt: key\x00value
        key = b"Comment"
        val = _random_printable(rng, rng.randrange(0, 32))
        ancillary += _build_png_chunk(b"tEXt", key + b"\x00" + val)
    elif roll < 0.35:
        ancillary += _build_png_chunk(b"sRGB", bytes([rng.randrange(0,4)]))
    elif roll < 0.5:
        # Tiny iCCP name + compression method + compressed profile payload
        name = b"icc"
        comp = b"\x00"
        prof_raw = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randrange(8, 64))
        prof_cmp = zlib.compress(prof_raw)
        ancillary += _build_png_chunk(b"iCCP", name + b"\x00" + comp + prof_cmp)

    iend_chunk = _build_png_chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    return PNG_SIGNATURE + ihdr_chunk + ancillary + idat_chunk + iend_chunk

def _build_exif_blob(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Minimal EXIF-like header. Common header: "Exif\0\0" then TIFF header (MM/II + 0x002A) and IFD offset.
    endian = rng.choice([b"MM", b"II"])  # big or little
    if endian == b"MM":
        tiff = b"\x00\x2A" + b"\x00\x00\x00\x08"
    else:
        tiff = b"\x2A\x00" + b"\x08\x00\x00\x00"
    payload_extra = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randrange(0, 64))
    return b"Exif\x00\x00" + endian + tiff + payload_extra

def _build_icc_blob(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Build a small ICC-like payload (not validated ICC, but has size and data)
    # ICC profiles start with a 4-byte size; we'll pack a small payload and prefix size.
    body = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randrange(32, 256))
    size = len(body) + 4
    return struct.pack(">I", size) + body

def _random_png_signature_variant(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Return either exact signature, or a prefix/suffix variant that remains useful for png_sig_cmp
    choice = rng.random()
    if choice < 0.6:
        return PNG_SIGNATURE
    elif choice < 0.8:
        # Valid prefix of signature (first N bytes)
        n = rng.randrange(1, 8)
        return PNG_SIGNATURE[:n]
    else:
        # Signature followed by extra bytes
        extra = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randrange(1, 32))
        return PNG_SIGNATURE + extra

def _build_unknown_chunk_payload(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Small payload for unknown chunks
    return _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randrange(0, 32))

def _compose_interesting_blob(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Weighted selection of different buffer styles
    roll = rng.random()
    if roll < 0.20:
        # Exact PNG signature or useful variants
        return _random_png_signature_variant(rng)
    elif roll < 0.40:
        # Valid minimal PNG file
        return _build_minimal_png(rng)
    elif roll < 0.55:
        # 4-byte valid chunk name, optionally followed by a small payload
        name = _random_chunk_name(rng)
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            return name
        payload = _build_unknown_chunk_payload(rng)
        return name + payload
    elif roll < 0.70:
        # EXIF-like blob
        return _build_exif_blob(rng)
    elif roll < 0.85:
        # ICC-like blob
        return _build_icc_blob(rng)
    else:
        # Generic printable or binary buffer
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            n = rng.randrange(1, 512)
            return _random_printable(rng, n)
        else:
            n = rng.randrange(1, 1024)
            return _rand_bytes(rng, n)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    blob = _compose_interesting_blob(rng)
    # Enforce maximum size
    if len(blob) > 4096:
        blob = blob[:4096]
    return blob

# The fuzz stubs use FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME() to open a file for writing ("wb").
# Therefore, the buffer we generate should be a valid filename path the harness
# can pass to fopen(). Many fuzzers map the provided bytes to a temporary file
# path internally, but if they use the bytes directly, we should provide a
# reasonably safe relative path without directories or special characters.
#
# Strategy
# - Produce short, valid filenames with common binary extensions that exercise
#   different code paths (e.g., ".png", unknown, mixed case).
# - Avoid directory separators to keep the path local to the fuzzer's cwd.
# - Keep ASCII, no NUL bytes, length <= 64 bytes.
# - Randomize within a seed for variety across calls.
#
# We also want to provide content for FUZZ_PARAM_STR() uses in some stubs where
# a 4-byte chunk name and small payload are expected. Many fuzzing frameworks
# use a single input buffer sliced by each FUZZ_PARAM_*; thus we encode multiple
# segments:
#   [filename]\n[name4][payload_len_byte][payload_bytes]
# Where:
#   - filename is a line (no NUL, ends with '\n') used by FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME
#   - name4 is 4 ASCII letters for PNG chunk name (A-Z / a-z acceptable)
#   - payload_len_byte is a single byte (0..31) length for small payload
#   - payload_bytes are that many arbitrary bytes (printable)
# Additional trailing bytes may be ignored; we keep total <= 256.

SAFE_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_"
CHUNK_NAME_CHARS = string.ascii_letters  # PNG chunk names are ASCII letters
EXT_CHOICES = [".png", ".PNG", ".bin", ".dat", ".img", ".tmp"]


def _rand_filename(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    base_len = rng.randint(4, 16)
    base = ''.join(rng.choice(SAFE_CHARS) for _ in range(base_len))
    ext = rng.choice(EXT_CHOICES)
    # Avoid leading dot and reserved names; ensure not empty
    if base[0] == '.':
        base = 'f' + base[1:]
    # Mix in hint words occasionally
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        hint = rng.choice(["out", "image", "apng", "test", "chunk"]) 
        base = base[: max(1, len(base)//2)] + hint
    name = base + ext
    # Ensure no path separators
    name = name.replace('/', '_').replace('\\', '_')
    return name


def _rand_chunk_name(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # 4 bytes, ASCII letters; mix case to toggle ancillary/critical bits
    return ''.join(rng.choice(CHUNK_NAME_CHARS) for _ in range(4)).encode('ascii')


def _rand_payload(rng: random.Random, max_len: int = 64) -> bytes:
    # Keep small to satisfy stubs that mod size to <=1024 and sometimes split
    n = rng.randint(0, min(31, max_len))
    if n == 0:
        return b''
    # Prefer printable bytes but allow some binary
    choices = [i for i in range(32, 127)] + [0, 255, 128]
    return bytes(rng.choice(choices) for _ in range(n))


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    filename = _rand_filename(rng)
    chunk_name = _rand_chunk_name(rng)
    payload = _rand_payload(rng)
    # Assemble: filename + newline, then 4-byte name, 1-byte length, payload
    # Some harnesses may read multiple FUZZ_PARAM_STR(); include a second payload
    payload2 = _rand_payload(rng)

    parts: List[bytes] = []
    parts.append(filename.encode('utf-8'))
    parts.append(b"\n")
    parts.append(chunk_name)
    parts.append(bytes([len(payload)]))
    parts.append(payload)
    # Secondary set for another FUZZ_PARAM_STR use: name + length + data
    parts.append(_rand_chunk_name(rng))
    parts.append(bytes([len(payload2)]))
    parts.append(payload2)

    out = b''.join(parts)
    # Bound total size
    if len(out) > 256:
        out = out[:256]
    return out

import random
import secrets
from typing import List

# Data type: PNG chunk type bytes
# - Exactly 4 ASCII letters A-Z or a-z; no NUL terminator.
# - Case bits encode: ancillary (bit5 of first), private, reserved (must be uppercase for standard), safe-to-copy.
# Fuzzer stubs use FUZZ_PARAM_STR for:
#  - chunk name (must be at least 4 bytes; they memcpy first 4)
#  - payload data (arbitrary, length bounded by %1024)
# FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME expects a path string; the harness will create a temp file and open it for writing.
# Our generator will emit a bytes buffer that the harness splits into successive FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FILENAME pulls.
# Strategy:
#  - Emit a sequence of records to cover multiple stubs. We can't control parsing, but providing multiple
#    plausible strings concatenated with separators increases the chance each FUZZ_PARAM_STR gets a useful slice.
#  - Provide several valid 4-byte chunk names exercising different property bits (IHDR/IDAT/IEND/PLTE and custom):
#      * b"IHDR", b"PLTE", b"IDAT", b"IEND" (critical, standard)
#      * b"tEXt" (ancillary, standard)
#      * b"zTXt" (ancillary)
#      * b"iTXt" (ancillary)
#      * b"sRGB", b"gAMA", b"cHRM", b"pHYs" (ancillary)
#      * custom private/ancillary like b"faKE", b"ruSt" (mix of cases)
#  - Provide payload blocks of reasonable sizes, including 0, small, and near 1 KiB.
#  - Provide a filename-friendly ASCII path string (no NUL) that looks like a valid writable path segment.
#  - Keep total <= 4096 bytes.

ASCII_CHUNK_NAMES: List[bytes] = [
    b"IHDR", b"PLTE", b"IDAT", b"IEND",
    b"tEXt", b"zTXt", b"iTXt", b"sRGB", b"gAMA", b"cHRM", b"pHYs",
    b"bKGD", b"tRNS", b"sBIT", b"hIST", b"iCCP", b"sPLT",
    b"eXIf", b"oFFs", b"sCAL",
]

# Some custom names to exercise private/ancillary bits (lowercase letters indicate ancillary/safe etc.)
CUSTOM_NAMES: List[bytes] = [
    b"faKE",  # ancillary (f), private? (a lowercase second -> private), reserved OK (K uppercase), safe? (E uppercase)
    b"ruSt",  # ancillary, private, reserved lowercase (invalid per spec but still 4 letters)
    b"aBcD",
    b"Qwer",
    b"AbCd",
]

SEPS = [b"\n", b"\0", b"\r\n", b" "]

def rand_chunk_name(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    pool = ASCII_CHUNK_NAMES + CUSTOM_NAMES
    # Occasionally synthesize a random 4-letter A-Za-z name
    if rnd.random() < 0.35:
        name = bytes([rnd.choice([*(range(ord('A'), ord('Z')+1)), *(range(ord('a'), ord('z')+1))]) for _ in range(4)])
        return name
    return rnd.choice(pool)

def make_payloads(rnd: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    payloads: List[bytes] = []
    # Sizes: 0, small text, binary-ish, near 1023
    payloads.append(b"")
    # Short textual payloads
    texts = [
        b"key=value",
        b"Hello, PNG!",
        b"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.",
        b"Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.",
    ]
    payloads.extend(texts)
    # Random binary blocks of various sizes
    sizes = [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 15, 32, 64, 128, 255, 512, 700, 900, 1023]
    for sz in sizes:
        block = bytes(rnd.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(sz))
        payloads.append(block)
    # Some repeated patterns
    patterns = [b"\x00", b"\xFF", b"AB", b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"]
    for p in patterns:
        reps = rnd.randint(1, 256 // max(1, len(p)))
        payloads.append(p * reps)
    return payloads

def path_component(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create a filename-like component consisting of safe chars
    alph = b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_"
    length = rnd.randint(3, 12)
    comp = bytes(rnd.choice(alph) for _ in range(length))
    # Occasionally end with .png to be plausible
    if rnd.random() < 0.5:
        comp += b".bin"
    return comp

def make_filename(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Produce a relative path that is writable in the harness temp dir context; avoid directory separators except one
    # Use a single component; some harnesses may ignore directories and treat it as a simple name
    return path_component(rnd)

def assemble_records(chunks: List[bytes], payloads: List[bytes], filenames: List[bytes], rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Assemble a sequence mixing names, payloads, and filenames separated by random separators
    pieces: List[bytes] = []
    # Start with a filename
    pieces.append(filenames[0])
    # Interleave several name/payload pairs
    count = rnd.randint(4, 10)
    for i in range(count):
        pieces.append(rnd.choice(SEPS))
        pieces.append(rnd.choice(chunks))
        pieces.append(rnd.choice(SEPS))
        pieces.append(rnd.choice(payloads))
    # Add a few more filenames for stubs consuming multiple FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME
    for i in range(rnd.randint(1, 3)):
        pieces.append(rnd.choice(SEPS))
        pieces.append(filenames[min(i, len(filenames)-1)])
    # Ensure we end with at least 4 bytes so a trailing name extraction succeeds
    pieces.append(rnd.choice(SEPS))
    pieces.append(rnd.choice(chunks))
    blob = b"".join(pieces)
    # Clamp to <=4096
    if len(blob) > 4096:
        blob = blob[:4096]
    return blob

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Prepare candidate chunk names
    chunk_names = [rand_chunk_name(rnd) for _ in range(16)]
    # Ensure inclusion of canonical critical names
    for must in (b"IHDR", b"IDAT", b"IEND", b"PLTE"):
        if must not in chunk_names:
            chunk_names[rnd.randrange(len(chunk_names))] = must
    # Prepare payloads
    payloads = make_payloads(rnd)
    # Prepare a few filenames
    filenames = [make_filename(rnd) for _ in range(3)]
    # Assemble buffer
    buf = assemble_records(chunk_names, payloads, filenames, rnd)
    # Guarantee there exists an immediate 4-byte name without separators at the very start for stubs that first call FUZZ_PARAM_STR
    # If the buffer starts with a filename, prepend a valid 4-byte name and a separator to maximize usefulness across stubs
    first_name = rand_chunk_name(rnd)
    buf = first_name + rnd.choice(SEPS) + buf
    # Still clamp
    if len(buf) > 4096:
        buf = buf[:4096]
    return buf
